title: Buttercup Trail
description: Follow a gentle-looking buttercup trail through flower fields, rolling hills and a narrow path to a quiet pond.

signs.text:
The gentle meadow
Hop the low countryside fences

The buttercup field
The stones weave between flower beds

The rolling hills
Follow the ridge above the buttercups

The narrow flower trail
Keep your jumps inside the flower-lined passage

The quiet pond
Land on the quiet stones between the lily pools
